name: roslyn-sense
description: C# language server backed by the RoslynSense shared daemon — the same loaded solution your MCP-connected AI assistant uses.

roslynSense.serverPath.description: Path to the roslyn-sense executable (dotnet tool). Defaults to 'roslyn-sense' on PATH.

roslynSense.solutionPath.description: Optional explicit .sln path. When empty, the server resolves the nearest solution from the workspace folder.

roslynSense.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication between VSCode and roslyn-sense.
